requirements.requirement: Release only the exact credential call reservation after a request is definitely not enqueued.
acceptance: Real restricted HTTP request with conflicting approval aliases refuses before enqueue and does not strand a credential.
Disconnected inbox rollback is exact; ambiguous delivery or a newer/rebound latch cannot be released.

requirements.requirement: Authenticate the complete caller-visible MCP result against its signed output before delivery or acknowledgement.
acceptance: Genuine signed evidence with substituted content, structuredContent or isError cannot expose the substituted result.
Invalid evidence cannot return forged output even if the reservation is fenced and no acknowledgement is minted.
Legitimate signed error results, once-only completion and replay remain valid.
requirements.reachability_limit: Worker-result substitution is the reviewed trust boundary; an unprivileged network injection route into the private worker event channel was not established.

requirements.requirement: Bind each request-stream event to the actual actor enqueue generation while preserving session notification ownership.
acceptance: After an old POST body is dropped, its late method event cannot be forwarded on a new POST stream.
Pre-enqueue events and a reused JSON-RPC identifier cannot terminate or lend authority to a different generation.
Roots, nested requests, GET notifications, absolute deadlines and cancellation remain correct.

requirements.requirement: Check fetched FX evidence against fresh trusted time without changing stored settlement replay or accepting future quotes.
acceptance: An injected trusted clock advancing during oracle I/O distinguishes a valid newly fetched quote from a truly future quote.
Both ordinary and durable callers preserve future/stale refusal, global clock/fence failure and original stored-disposition replay.
requirements.reachability_limit: A prior full suite failed with authorized fallback10 rather than converted1. The stale pre-fetch timestamp explains a possible production path but has not yet been reproduced by a deterministic Original.

requirements.requirement: A fresh Apply command cannot reinstall the same effect after its committed removal; exact historical command replay remains read-only.
acceptance: Real egress, throttle, capability-set and session suspension Apply/Remove/fresh-Apply controls, preserving exact old command replay.
Atomic same tenant/action/effect journal barrier with bounded verified reads and fatal malformed or unavailable custody.
requirements.reachability_limit: Three-kind lane probe demonstrates the regression; session suspension is analogous and still needs its own Original. These effect repairs are not yet integrated in the Root source.

requirements.requirement: Concurrent plans freezing the same lineage retain each plan contribution through renewal, restart and independent lift.
acceptance: Use the normal executor: the second plan must reach its intended suspension with its authenticated observed base.
Lifting the first plan preserves the second restriction and external issuance fence; renew/restart retain both obligations.
requirements.reachability_limit: A probe that directly invokes suspension after freeze failure does not demonstrate normal executor continuation.

ownership: Codex successors on isolated branches after explicit Claude quota handoff; Root alone integrates.
remaining_acceptance: Genuine Original failure, reviewed repair and current focused controls for each new obligation.
Combined-source owning/strict/native/cold/trusted/hosted qualification and protected landing; no quota or baseline waiver.
